name: Beat map and narrative arc planner
purpose: Narrative layer before the storyboard: arc library, beat map scaffold, planning-level checks (visual restating narration, repeated compositions, over-spent emphasis, generate-without-fallback, unsourced claims) and storyboard derivation from measured audio timing.
capabilities: storyboard: contiguous timed scenes from audio/timeline.json

compatibility.notes: Arc library in specs/narrative-arcs.json (12 arcs, 6 adapted from the Vox beat-layer reference).

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

security.notes: Reads and writes projects/<slug>/beatmap.json and storyboard.json only.

approval_evidence: Exercised in tests/test-creative-intelligence.py (54 tests) and on three demonstration projects on the M2 host (2026-11-02). Experimental: not promoted to approved because that requires a render-host evidence trail over more than one session.
